title: Post-review optimization-budget and MultiQT feedback controls
evidence: Post-review supplement after all enhanced-study outcomes were inspected; not a new independent confirmation or preregistration

training.optimization: Original AdamW/lr/standardization/shuffling/batch4096; full shuffled epochs plus final partial epoch until exact target number of updates. No early stop or new selection.
training.interpretation: Same optimizer updates, not identical unique data or example visits. Short history still changes recency and standardized feature statistics.

multiqt.unchanged: Original ordered nonnegative raw reference, normalization, adaptive eta, lazy release, isotonic projection and start time
multiqt.comparison: Q1-Q0 isolates final output clamping with identical shadow recursion; Q2-Q1 changes feedback used in subsequent updates. Q2 must match saved original R5 exactly.

statistics.sensitivity_blocks: H,2H,4H,56 days or8 weeks, only T>=4L
statistics.seed_handling: Average scores, not predictions, then shared paired time blocks
statistics.scope: Descriptive intervals conditional on source/cohort/time; no new multiple-testing or independence claims

presentation.full_methods: All prespecified R0-R5, each against same-calendar Raw; R5 retains original secondary status
presentation.dominicks: Recompute pooled, equal-category and equal-date weighting; no recovery of missing targets
presentation.metadata: Correct presentation copies only; original frozen archive immutable
presentation.simulation: Retain original misspecified-distribution simulation in appendix; no oracle additions or new real dataset
